title: Pure Altergeist
summary: Altergeist cards only, with generic staples. Altergeist is a Spellcaster Trap-control and Link-climbing deck that bounces and sends its own cards to negate effects, bounce opposing threats, and recur resources every turn.

summary.title: Starters
points: Altergeist Marionetter Sets any Altergeist Trap directly from the Deck on Normal Summon, then sends an Altergeist card from your field to the GY to revive an Altergeist monster.
Altergeist Meluseek attacks directly to send an opposing card to the GY, and searches any Altergeist monster (except itself) whenever it is sent from the field to the GY.

Altergeist Multifaker Special Summons itself from the hand whenever you activate a Trap Card, then Special Summons an Altergeist monster from the Deck in Defense Position (locking you into Altergeist summons that turn).
Altergeist Malwisp Special Summons itself when added to the hand except by drawing, and revives an Altergeist from the GY on Normal or Special Summon.

summary.title: Opening: Meluseek + Pookuery (or Marionetter)
steps: Normal Summon Altergeist Meluseek and use it with Altergeist Pookuery from your hand to Link Summon Altergeist Hexstia.
Chain 1 Meluseek to search Altergeist Malwisp and Chain 2 Pookuery to add itself back to your hand; Malwisp then triggers to Special Summon itself and revive Meluseek.

Link Summon Altergeist Primebanshee or Altergeist Adminia, sending Hexstia to search Altergeist Protocol or Personal Spoofing and setting up Altergeist Multifaker + Silquitous for the opponent's turn.

summary.title: Trap & Bounce Loop
summary.text: Flipping any Trap triggers Altergeist Multifaker in the hand to summon itself and pull Altergeist Silquitous from the Deck. Silquitous is a Quick Effect bounce that returns another Altergeist card you control (such as Multifaker or a spent Altergeist Manifestation) to bounce an opponent's card to the hand, re-arming Multifaker in your hand for the next turn while recovering an Altergeist Trap if Silquitous goes to the GY.

summary.title: Control & Link Bosses
points: Altergeist Protocol prevents the activation and negation of your face-up Altergeist effects, and sends another face-up Altergeist card you control to the GY to negate and destroy an opposing monster effect.
Altergeist Hexstia (Link-2) gains ATK equal to the Altergeist it points to and tributes that monster to negate a Spell/Trap effect.
Altergeist Adminia (Link-4) Sets an Altergeist Trap directly from the Deck on Link Summon and sends a card you control to the GY as a Quick Effect to permanently steal an opposing Effect Monster.
Altergeist Memorygant (Link-4) tributes a monster to gain its ATK, destroys another monster after battle, and attacks again to close out games.

summary.title: Traps & Locks
points: Personal Spoofing shuffles an Altergeist card from your hand or face-up field into the Deck once per turn to add any Altergeist monster, triggering Multifaker on activation and Malwisp on search.

Altergeist Manifestation revives an Altergeist and banishes itself from the GY to recover an Altergeist Trap; Altergeist Revitalization revives an Altergeist Link Monster and banishes itself for an immediate Altergeist Normal Summon.

Altergeist Multifaker locks you into Special Summoning Altergeist monsters during the turn you use its Deck-summon effect, so the Extra Deck is built around Altergeist Links and Altergeist Dragvirion.

main: Starter: Sets an Altergeist Trap from the Deck; swaps a card on the field for a GY monster.
Summons itself when you activate a Trap; summons an Altergeist from the Deck.
Newest Tuner: summons itself when searched; revives an Altergeist.
Attacks directly; searches an Altergeist when it leaves the field.
Quick Effect: bounces one of yours to bounce one of theirs; recovers a Trap.
Newest: draws on damage; mills an Altergeist card when it leaves the field.
Summons itself to negate an attack and a face-up card.
Tributes itself to excavate an Altergeist card.
Tuner that shields your other Altergeists from attacks and targeting.
Continuous Trap: trades an Altergeist card for an Altergeist monster from the Deck.
Makes your Altergeist effects unnegatable; negates a monster effect.
Revives an Altergeist; recovers an Altergeist Trap from the GY.
Negates a Trap by discarding an Altergeist.
Newest Trap: revives an Altergeist Link; grants a Normal Summon.
Protects an Altergeist from attacks and targeting.
Summons an Altergeist when your card is destroyed; recovers one from the GY.
extra: Link-2: negates a Spell/Trap by tributing; searches when it leaves.
Newest Link-4: Sets an Altergeist Trap from the Deck; steals a monster.
Link-3: tributes for an Altergeist from the Deck; recovers when it leaves.
Link-4: destroys a monster after each kill and attacks again.
Level 6 Synchro: negates an attack by bouncing an Altergeist.
Link-2: steals a monster from their GY after damage.
